semantic_label: pair vector insert: shift the tail when the cursor is below the limit, or grow, copy, release and retarget when it is full
declaration: void __thiscall pair_vector_insert_004786e0(OpaqueSlotVector* receiver, TargetWord position, const TargetWord* value)

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x18
abi.return_contract: none; the target returns no value and EAX is not an answer

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: read the cursor at receiver + 0x04 and the limit at + 0x08
when the cursor equals the limit, compute the element count with a byte span shifted right by three, double it or take one when empty
allocate through 0x0042dee0 with the pair stride 0x8, copy the prefix, write the new pair, copy the tail and release the old base through 0x00f47380 when the word before it is non-zero
retarget the cursor, the limit and the arena to the fresh block and return
otherwise test position <= value < last, and when the value pointer falls inside the vector advance it by the eight byte stride so the later stores do not read a word they have just written
copy the last pair down by eight bytes, move the span from the insertion point, write the pair and advance the cursor

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target reads only the four words of the slot vector
0x0042dee0 and 0x00f47380 are dependency-only ports, so the grow and the release are unverified in this package
the guard word read at base - 4 is the inline arena sentinel and its runtime meaning is undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reads the value pointer as an independent source; the assembly compares it against the insertion position and the cursor, so the guard is position <= value < last, and the +8 skip only fires when the value points into the vector
the decompilation performs the pair copy before the tail move; the assembly moves first and then writes, so the corrected model keeps the move before the write
the decompilation reports one exit; the assembly has a fast return after the retarget and a shared epilogue after the in place path, so the model keeps two exits
